description: Test vectors for the runtime-callback token (design §1.10). meeting-api builds the callbackUrl it hands the runtime as <MEETING_API_URL>/runtime/callback?t=<token>, and POST /runtime/callback recomputes the token from the event's workloadId. The secret here is a test-only literal, never deployed.
id_rule: workloadId: meeting-api names the workload at spawn (mtg-<meeting id>-<first 8 of the connection id>) and the runtime echoes it in every RuntimeEvent (runtime.v1, required)
